Subject: Expo curb canopy permit + courier routing — layout and action items

Hi Alex / Sophie —

We reviewed the initial footprint for EdgeSummit (corner A12). Two quick asks before I file the final permit:

1) Confirm the canopy overhang and whether the city requires a 5ft clear path for the sidewalk — I recall an ADA note but need the explicit dimension to include in the permit.
2) Courier windows: we have three inbound crates (CRATE-501/502/503). Sophie, can your team confirm a 2-hour dock window on Tuesday morning (08:00–10:00) and a 1-hour pick on Wednesday evening (18:00–19:00)?

Attached: expo_curb_canopy_draft_layout_v2.pdf (layout with dimensions), brand_asset_manifest_v3.xlsx (what's in crates), site_photo_cornerA_20270503.jpg

If we can lock canopy clearance and courier windows by EOD today I’ll submit the permit to City Permits and loop facilities for the power drop.

Thanks —
Marcus
Senior Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expo curb canopy permit + courier routing — layout and action items

Marcus — thanks for the layout. A few notes from ShowOps after walk-through: 

- ADA clearance: city requires 5 ft continuous clear pedestrian path. Our canopy can be set back 6 ft from the curb to remain compliant and still keep a 3 ft demo corridor. I updated the attached PDF to show the 6 ft setback option (page 2).
- Fire/sprinkler heads: there is a low sprinkler branch at 10 ft in that corner. The canopy height needs to be 11.5 ft min to meet local fire code. I’ve annotated the clearance on the drawing.
- Footing: temporary surface-mounted weights are acceptable; no trenching allowed in that zone.

Action items for Redwood: confirm canopy height 11.5 ft and sign-off on setback so we can reference those dims in the permit text.

Attached: expo_curb_canopy_draft_layout_v2.pdf (updated with annotations)

On courier windows — we prefer a single consolidated inbound window to reduce forklift swaps. If Sophie can hold 08:00–10:00 we’ll stage the three crates in order CRATE-501 nearest to the booth.

Alex
Operations Lead, ShowOps

--- Attachment: expo_curb_canopy_draft_layout_v2.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks all — quick summary and next steps: 

- Canopy dimensions: confirm 11.5 ft min height and 6 ft setback (ShowOps annotated layout accepted). I will include these dims verbatim in the permit.
- Courier windows: Fleet Logistics inbound Tue 08:00–10:00 (CRATE-501 load-first); outbound Wed 18:00–19:00 confirmed.
- Permit submission: I will submit to City Permits today with the annotated layout and request the temporary curb hold for inspection. Link: https://cityevents.gov/permits/EDGE-2027-EXPO-45
- On-site POC: Lauren Bishop will be the field POC for crate intake and vendor coordination. Lauren — can you confirm the mobile number you want on the permit?
- Facilities: Naomi, please open a ticket for a single 20A power drop to the corner pedestal (same side as the canopy). We need power run note included for permit so the city knows we’ll be powering demo equipment.

If there are no objections I’ll file at 16:00 PT and share the portal confirmation.

Marcus
Senior Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
